item.name: Get list of Clozd program touchpoints

request.name: Get list of Clozd program touchpoints

description.content:
Get a paginated list of touchpoints with basic fields and share link (if there is published feedback). See /programs/:program_id/touchpoints/:touchpoint_id endpoint to get a specific touchpoint with details. Make sure the header is set with a key value pair being Key: x-api-token Value: (api token provided from the settings section within the Clozd application).
 - :program_id is required, you can get the program id from the settings page within the Clozd app. 

**NOTE**: this endpoint is only usable for program types other than 'win-loss'.

query.description: Returns only touchpoints with published feedback that have been published or updated since the date and time specified. See clozd_publish_date and clozd_update_date. NOTE: Specifying this parameter will by definition filter out touchpoints which have no published feedback. It will also enable periodic query of incremental changes since last pull (instead of always having to pull all touchpoints). (max:25 chars, ISO8601 date-time format)

item.name: Create or update Clozd touchpoint and participant data

request.name: Create or update Clozd touchpoint and participant data

description.content:
Create or update 1 to many touchpoints and 0 to many participants associated with the touchpoint. Make sure the header is set with a key value pair being Key: x-api-token Value: (api token provided from the settings section within the Clozd application). The body of the post request will follow the schema below. If an attribute is required or a wrong value type is provided the POST request will be rolled back and rejected. 
 - Program id is required, you can get the program id from the settings page within the Clozd app. 
 - Custom fields are acceptable. The key name must match the name of the field name created in Clozd app exactly. 
 - Participants are included within the touchpoint object 
 - Names of properties and display names are not always the same

**NOTE**: this endpoint is only usable for program types other than 'win-loss'.
